description: Frozen timing-trained encoders on new amplitude TRAIN/VALIDATION sources; zero model updates and newly fitted fixed heads.

limitations: Actual CUDA encoder forwards, immutable model parameter checks and generation sequence are producer/admission/source-bound.
Ordinary checkpoint CUDA model/optimizer bodies are not decoded; whole checkpoint bytes are SHA/FNV-bound and their CPU companions/new provider audits are checked.
This reader checks exact saved original CUDA export bytes, not a new encoder forward.
SVD fitting and Adam head optimization are source/admission-bound; saved TRAIN maps, covariance and predictions are independently replayed.
Intervals are within-master source-group bootstrap conditional on each fixed fitted head; no across-encoder interval.
Mixed whole-callback timers include immutable-parent hashing, CPU transfers and IO; pure GPU compute time is unmeasured.

recipe.data_generation: existing Task::amplitude unchanged: label0=.5*base+nuisance, label1=2*base+nuisance; source phase/nuisance/support paired
recipe.normalization: Raw/mask/native: outer TRAIN normalization then each head TRAIN normalization. PCA only: raw TRAIN normalization -> PCA32 -> each head TRAIN normalization. No PCA after an encoder.

methods.description: 288 new-TRAIN-scaled observed values plus288 visibility flags; no encoder
32 raw TRAIN-fitted principal components; no encoder
paired point0 mode2/mixer1 encoder, old timing TRAIN-fitted scaler, new amplitude heads
ordinary learned global32 timing-trained encoder, retained alt-01 instances
same inference architecture, lighter .15 context-deletion timing-trained alt-01 instances

disposition.conclusion: Both frozen native encoders preserve accessible amplitude on these new sources. Untrained intact performance prevents a learned-training gain claim. Trained mean deletion performance exceeds the untrained mean; v4 exceeds v7 mean performance here. No internal causal explanation or broad task claim follows.
